title: Crunchy Velvet Wrap
description: A sweet and crunchy treat made with velvet, gelatin, and wrap.

ingredients.name: Velvet
ingredients.notes: Crushed or chopped velvet for garnish

instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1 tablespoon of water and let it sit for 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sugar and crushed velvet.
Place the wrap on a flat surface and brush the edges with water.
Sprinkle the gelatin mixture evenly over the center of the wrap.
Top the gelatin mixture with the velvet-sugar mixture.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap tightly.
Place the roll seam-side down on a plate and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Cut the roll into slices and serve.
Garnish with additional crushed velvet if desired.
